Let's walk through the process of setting up your development environment step by step. First, open your terminal and navigate to your project directory. Next, create a virtual environment by running the command python dash m venv dot venv. Once that completes, activate the environment using source dot venv slash bin slash activate on Mac or Linux. Now, install the required dependencies with pip install dash r requirements dot txt. Wait for the installation to finish. Finally, verify everything works by running python dash m pytest. If all tests pass, you're ready to start coding. Remember to activate your virtual environment each time you work on the project.
